changelog: **A mentee owner manages their own team and weekly meeting (#2272):** who manages a project's team and whom they may seat is one pure rule, `src/lib/projectTeamRule.ts` (`canManageProjectTeam`, `addableSeats`, `memberAddRefusal`, `canWriteProjectSeries`). A MENTEE owner may now add their own ACTIVE mentor(s) and those mentors' other mentees (`mentee_owner_invite` is gone); a mentor keeps "any mentor/admin plus own mentees". Anyone outside the set — an unconnected org member, another tenant's person, an unknown id — answers the same `404 not_addable`; a non-manager who is not on the team gets 404 instead of 403. New mentee-safe picker `GET /api/projects/[id]/members/candidates`, filtered by the same rule. `POST/PUT/DELETE /api/meeting-series` admit a MENTEE for their own project's series; a relation's standing 1:1 stays the mentor's.

en: Mentees who own a project can now add their mentor and fellow mentees to the team, and set up the project's weekly meeting themselves.
tr: Proje sahibi mentiler artık mentorlarını ve aynı mentordaki diğer mentileri ekibe ekleyebilir, projenin haftalık toplantısını kendileri kurabilir.
de: Mentees, denen ein Projekt gehört, können jetzt ihren Mentor und andere Mentees ins Team holen und das wöchentliche Projektmeeting selbst einrichten.
